source_read_scope: The five final shared local drafts were statically reviewed. The parent reports the same bytes uploaded to NEW; remote publication/transport equality was not independently executed by this review. Canonical source paths above are the intended runtime locations.
allowed_actions: Metadata/data identity binding and exact source/dependency transport for this single fixed carrier.
Exactly one prescribed tiny synthetic CPU gate, followed by the specified Torch-free metadata freeze. No actual pretrained model construction or QA forward is authorized.
After actual CPU_GATE and READY exist, submit them for a separate model admission review; no automatic dispatch activation.

resolved_findings.detail: The original manifest/SPLIT are fixed by accepted SHA; each selected image must match SPLIT.image_sha256. Freeze pins both historical proof objects, checks the base-weight mapping and inherited base-small-files, compares execution_policy to the inherited proof, and retains proof/data identities for ready() revalidation. Actual methods.py is included as a runtime dependency.

Child identity polling now occurs inside ownership-aware try/finally. A running child is signalled only if current UID/startticks/PGID equal the captured own child identity; otherwise NEEDS_ATTENTION is written. The model polling sleep is limited by remaining time. Actual exit evidence and first-STARTED closure remain required.

Verifier requires the exact five planned evidence files, their SHA, STARTED/READY/boot/end identity/exit binding, same PID/visible GPU resource records and all six packed-group phases. It checks physical package stat sizes, all 7680 step witnesses and the complete GMP event schedule, exact fractions and twelve per-event keep counts.

Within the existing eight synthetic updates, the audit asserts masked parameters/gradients/both moments are zero and final keep counts are exactly one quarter. No extra updates are added. The shared FP16 basis is checked finite after casting, alongside existing packed-value checks and physical shared-alias reload.

accepted_static_contracts: Full short-axis SVD and zero extra shared columns supply a real-arithmetic initialization basis; no FP16 bitwise equivalence or preserved function is assumed.
One shared Basis per group participates in the single joint four-layer loss and optimizer update; the fixed 40-epoch/32-QA/GMP recipe is unchanged.

Final PackedFactor objects retain only nonzero FP16 values, bitmaps and shared bases. Original FFN modules are replaced in the public bridge and the same native-core graph. No dense Factor remains in the final registered graph.
Actual serialized compact-model reload precedes all compact diagnostics; complete registered weight/buffer digest and layout are checked before/after diagnostics, with unchanged non-FFN state.

The full-answer loss AST differs only in tokenizer truncation parameters; original greedy generation policy and references are used, and the sole verifier performs the one planned original score pass.

One 3600-second model interval includes construction, restoration, persistence, reload and diagnostics. Completion/integrity plus actual coefficient/package thresholds and the fixed S1 F1/NLL rule determine close versus further necessity review only.
activation_review_requirements: Actual OLD transport, actual source/dependency identities, actual CPU_GATE and metadata READY remain to be inspected; this source review does not claim them completed.
Any later activation must bind the final READY and actual approved host/resource scope. The presence of dispatch.py is not authorization to invoke it.
limitations: The CPU gate has not been executed by this reviewer and cannot certify actual CUDA FP16 numerics, original model compatibility or quality.
Storage coefficients and byte budgets remain design values until actual packed-model and package checks pass; temporary dense expansion and process memory are separately charged.
S1 diagnostic success is an investment rule on an explored first-task subset, not whole-pretraining/five-domain preservation, noninferiority, a continual-learning benefit or novelty.
This does not authorize U/V adaptation comparisons, full 19-stage training, additional configurations, retries after first STARTED failure or restoration of any closed prior branch.
